tonal_mismatches.line_excerpt: A man insulted Jesus behind His back. Jesus complimented him to his face.
tonal_mismatches.rationale: Flat delivery lets the paradox land on its own, which is a valid reading, but a slightly more reflective register is worth an ear-test since this is the hook line.

concerns: Final Jesus quote keeps the mid-quote ellipsis ('these... Hereafter') verbatim from the source KJV text -- same TTS prosody note as the verify pass, listen for an overlong pause on synth.
Five narrator transition lines in a row carry [serious] -- deliberate (each sets up a different attributed quote) and stays under the 70% flat-read threshold, but worth a listen for contour.
All six quoted lines are attributed to jesus or nathanael only, matching the closed roster; no invented speaker names.
